newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak SAX index falls led by Slovakofarma.
newsitem.headline: Slovak SAX index falls led by Slovakofarma.

text.p: Slovak drug producer Slovakofarma dropped sharply in thinner trading on the Bratislava bourse (BSE) on Tuesday but gains to other blue chips prevented the SAX index from falling more than slightly.
Slovakofarma plunged 298 crowns to 4,252 but dealers said the issue traded only seven shares.
Elsehere, steel maker VSZ fell one crown to close at 740. Traders said expectations of dividend payments could push the issue up in the medium term.
Overall, volume decreased to 195,115 shares, from 343,657 stocks traded on Monday, and turnover eased to 111.02 million crowns from 118.91 million.
